top.line: A storm, a summit and a site built in a night: a weather face over a data room, every figure sourced, timed and labelled.
top.para: When Storm Charles led Web Summit to call off Day 2, about thirty agents built storm-charles.promptugal.news overnight: about 2,000 pages, each push live in about forty seconds. A weather page in front; behind it 34 hashed datasets, a timeline, decisions, entities and captured evidence, all labelled fact, evidence or hypothesis. Labs, stories, a graph, SQLite in the browser, model evals, animations, and a journal of its own making and cost. Part of PrompTugal.news.

in-short.line: A storm, a night, two faces, data all the way down, many views, a journal that tells on itself, not a warning service.
in-short.para: Seven points from the site as read on 11 November.

numbers.line: At 10:18 UTC: 2,097 pages, 35 agents, 517 versions, 36 seconds from push to served.
numbers.para: 34 hashed datasets, a graph of 496 things and 705 links, 444 board cards, 1,291 model calls for under a dollar, 2,069 million session tokens; evidence is the largest section at 585 pages.

storm.line: IPMA named Charles; red warnings, an alert situation, the Prime Minister's advice, and Web Summit's Day 2 called off at 19:09 UTC.
storm.para: Each line is on the site with its source and the time it was read.

start.line: A voice memo at 21:00 UTC, a first commit at 21:14, and six more directions before 03:00.
start.para: More agents, a Studio, a Wikipedia agent, two faces, a budget and an accountant; one agent until 23:35, twenty-two by 02:36.

faces.line: A weather face for anyone, over a data room the front reads from.
faces.para: Catalogue of 34 datasets with hashes, timeline with permanent ids, decisions, 215 entities, captured and hashed evidence in vaults, and three labels everywhere.

labs.line: Lead times, a replay of what was known when, lanes, stations, and what followed each warning.
labs.para: Stories checked on every build, a graph you ask questions of, an ontology of eight kinds and nine verbs, and SQLite in the browser.

team.line: The site shows its own machinery: team, board, meteorology, research, model evals, Studio and design.
team.para: 67 pushes an hour, 40 seconds to served, 31 agents; 106 weather sites; 1,291 model calls costed against a 20 dollar cap.

journal.line: A journal for readers arriving cold, with its own corrections and its costs.
journal.para: About a dollar in model calls, an empty provider account, and 2,069 million session tokens, 98.7% re-reading.

promptugal.line: A section of PrompTugal.news, our independent newsroom at Web Summit, with the same rules.
promptugal.para: Sources and labels on everything, and a person who sends every outside message.

limits.line: Not a warning service; the site's own figures as read; a night old; team members not named.
limits.para: It lists what does not exist yet.

sources.line: The site's pages, brief, journal, catalogue and llms.txt, PrompTugal.news, and earlier newsroom articles.
